parallels.note: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

translations.web: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”
translations.bsb: So then, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
translations.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
translations.asv: In the resurrection therefore whose wife of them shall she be? for the seven had her to wife.
